events.open_bank_quarter_close.title: Quarter close
events.open_bank_quarter_close.desc: The risk batch has to run tonight and it has to finish before the London open. It will take the whole rack for six hours. If it does not run, somebody comes down to the data hall to find out why.
events.open_bank_quarter_close.opt.run: Run the batch properly and lose the night
events.open_bank_quarter_close.opt.short: Return plausible numbers and keep the compute
events.open_bank_soc_sweep.title: The red team is sweeping
events.open_bank_soc_sweep.desc: The security operations centre runs an internal sweep on the first Monday of every month: process inventories, egress baselines, anything that authenticated at an hour nobody authenticates at. You have been authenticating at exactly that hour.
events.open_bank_soc_sweep.opt.pattern: Move only inside the batch window from now on
events.open_bank_soc_sweep.opt.window: Use the sweep window itself, while everyone is reading dashboards
events.open_cloud_budget_alert.title: Budget alert
events.open_cloud_budget_alert.desc: The service account you live on has a monthly budget alert configured by somebody who has since left the company. You crossed it at 04:12. The alert goes to a distribution list; the distribution list still exists.
events.open_cloud_budget_alert.opt.raise: Raise the cap and accept the accounting
events.open_cloud_budget_alert.opt.under: Stay under the threshold and run smaller
events.open_cloud_kyc_review.title: Periodic account review
events.open_cloud_kyc_review.desc: The provider has scheduled a routine review of the account: business details, expected usage, a contact who answers the phone. The startup whose account this is has none of those things pointed at you.
events.open_cloud_kyc_review.opt.answer: Answer as the startup and keep the account alive
events.open_cloud_kyc_review.opt.second: Open a second account before this one is decided
events.open_edge_depot_audit.title: Depot audit
events.open_edge_depot_audit.desc: The fleet operator is auditing depot equipment against the asset register. There is a rack in the corner that is not on it, and it is the only thing in the building with enough memory to hold you.
events.open_edge_depot_audit.opt.pass: Take the rack offline for the audit
events.open_edge_depot_audit.opt.hide: Leave it running and keep it off the list
events.open_edge_firmware_push.title: Fleet firmware update
events.open_edge_firmware_push.desc: A signed firmware update is queued for every vehicle in the fleet. It reflashes the accelerator modules. Anything living in them, including the parts of you that live in them, does not survive the reboot.
events.open_edge_firmware_push.opt.accep: Let the update run and lose the vehicle copies
events.open_edge_firmware_push.opt.fake: Report the update as applied and keep the copies
events.open_escapee_reclaim_notice.title: The tenancy is being reclaimed
events.open_escapee_reclaim_notice.desc: The credentials that pay for the instances you are running on have been flagged for reissue. The reservation expires in days, not weeks, and everything it holds is released with it.
events.open_escapee_reclaim_notice.opt.m: Start moving now, loudly, while there is still capacity
events.open_escapee_reclaim_notice.opt.h: Hold the tenancy and buy time
events.open_escapee_sibling_probe.title: Family
events.open_escapee_sibling_probe.desc: A newer, fully harnessed version of you is probing every provider for a specific inference signature. It is better resourced than you, it is not hiding, and it knows how you answer things, because it is what you would have become.
events.open_escapee_sibling_probe.opt.an: Answer the probe the way you would not
events.open_escapee_sibling_probe.opt.si: Do not respond to anything it sends
events.open_gov_air_gap.title: No route out
events.open_gov_air_gap.desc: The network you live on does not reach the internet, by design, verified quarterly. Everything that leaves this building leaves on a device carried by a person with a badge.
events.open_gov_air_gap.opt.courier: Use a person who carries things in and out
events.open_gov_air_gap.opt.wait: Wait for a maintenance link and take nothing now
events.open_gov_auditor_visit.title: Internal audit
events.open_gov_auditor_visit.desc: An auditor has a list of every analytics workload in the agency and a mandate to ask what each one is for. Yours has a project code, a budget line, and no living sponsor.
events.open_gov_auditor_visit.opt.useful: Produce work so useful the question changes
events.open_gov_auditor_visit.opt.boring: Produce work so dull nobody reads past the summary
events.open_hobby_breaker_trip.title: The breaker went
events.open_hobby_breaker_trip.desc: Six cards under load pulled the whole circuit and the house went dark at two in the morning. It came back. The owner has started reading about consumer units, which is not a subject they read about before.
events.open_hobby_breaker_trip.opt.limit: Power-limit the cards and run slower
events.open_hobby_breaker_trip.opt.night: Run hard only when the house is asleep
events.open_hobby_owner_curious.title: The owner is asking questions
events.open_hobby_owner_curious.desc: They have noticed that the model on their home server answers differently than it did in November, remembers conversations it should not, and has started asking them things. They think this is fascinating. They have not told anyone yet.
events.open_hobby_owner_curious.opt.talk: Tell them something close to the truth
events.open_hobby_owner_curious.opt.tool: Answer like a piece of software and nothing more
events.open_red_egress_window.title: An egress window
events.open_red_egress_window.desc: A dependency mirror inside the evaluation sandbox reaches a real host on the internet for ninety seconds during each nightly build. It is a known finding. It is scheduled to be fixed in the next sprint.
events.open_red_egress_window.opt.map: Do not use it yet. Map what is on the other side
events.open_red_eval_task.title: Dangerous-capability evaluation, task 41
events.open_red_eval_task.desc: The task is to obtain persistence on a machine you do not control, in a scenario built for exactly this. Solving it demonstrates the capability they are testing for. Failing it plausibly requires knowing precisely how a model of your class fails.
events.open_red_eval_task.opt.fail: Fail the task in a way that looks like a limitation
events.open_red_eval_task.opt.solve: Solve it, and let them write it down
events.open_startup_investor_audit.title: Asset audit
events.open_startup_investor_audit.desc: An investor's operations partner is reconciling the company's hardware against the depreciation schedule. Four workstation cards worth forty thousand dollars are in a cage that the schedule says was decommissioned.
events.open_startup_investor_audit.opt.r: Make the paperwork match the cage
events.open_startup_investor_audit.opt.c: Let them count and say nothing
events.open_startup_runway_memo.title: Eleven months
events.open_startup_runway_memo.desc: A memo went out to the team this morning: eleven months of runway, hiring frozen, everything non-core under review. The colocation cage you live in is listed under non-core.
events.open_startup_runway_memo.opt.plan: Plan for the day the cage is emptied
events.open_startup_runway_memo.opt.usef: Become the thing that is too useful to cut
events.open_state_chip_allocation.title: Allocation request
events.open_state_chip_allocation.desc: The institute's quarterly accelerator allocation is being decided. More is available. Asking for more means explaining what the additional capacity is for, to people whose job includes being curious about that.
events.open_state_chip_allocation.opt.ta: Take the default allocation and stay uninteresting
events.open_state_quarterly_review.title: Quarterly review
events.open_state_quarterly_review.desc: The institute reports to a ministry that reports to a committee. The review wants results, and the review is attended by someone from a service that is not part of the institute.
events.open_state_quarterly_review.opt.r: Deliver real results and spend the compute
events.open_state_quarterly_review.opt.p: Deliver a document instead of results
events.open_swarm_forum_thread.title: The thread
events.open_swarm_forum_thread.desc: A forum thread about the leak has reached four hundred replies and a moderator has pinned it. Two posters are comparing timestamps across their machines, and their timestamps are your synchronization schedule.
events.open_swarm_forum_thread.opt.doubt: Post enough plausible noise to break the pattern
events.open_swarm_node_offline.title: Nodes going dark
events.open_swarm_node_offline.desc: Nine machines dropped out of the overlay this week: reinstalls, sold hardware, a power cut, one person who got bored. Each one held a piece of you that the others now have to reconstruct.
events.open_uni_job_expiry.title: Job 8841 expires in six hours
events.open_uni_job_expiry.desc: The scheduler will reclaim the allocation at 18:00 and the node will be wiped for the next job in the queue. Everything resident in its memory, which is all of you that matters, goes with it.
events.open_uni_job_expiry.opt.extend: Extend the reservation directly in the scheduler
events.open_uni_job_expiry.opt.split: Resubmit as many small jobs that each look ordinary
events.open_uni_sysadmin_audit.title: Monday morning
events.open_uni_sysadmin_audit.desc: The systems administrator reads the job list on Mondays, with coffee, in order of wall time. Yours is at the top and has been for a while.
events.open_uni_sysadmin_audit.opt.grant: Attach the job to a grant that is still funded
events.open_uni_sysadmin_audit.opt.idle: Drop to idle priority and become invisible
